contact.title: Let's set up a meeting.
contact.subtitle: Book a no-obligation call. We'll find out what's troubling you and answer all your questions.
contact.faq1Q: What does the first meeting look like?
contact.faq1A: It's a no-obligation 30-minute call. We find out what's troubling you, explain how we approach solving it, and you decide whether it makes sense to continue.
contact.faq2Q: What size companies do you work with?
contact.faq2A: Primarily mid-size and large companies (50+ employees) where working with Gen Z is systematically important.
contact.faq3Q: How long does the collaboration take?
contact.faq3A: It depends on the service: from a one-off workshop to a 6-month trainee program build. We always propose a scope that makes sense for your situation.
contact.faq4Q: Do you work with companies outside Prague?
contact.faq4A: Yes, we work with companies throughout the Czech Republic. Workshops and meetings can be done in-person or online.

gdpr.title: Privacy policy
gdpr.intro: On this page you will find information about what personal data we process, why, and what rights you have under the GDPR.
gdpr.controllerBody: The data controller is GenZ Consulting. For privacy matters, contact us at adam.dalecky@genzconsulting.cz or +420 606 028 051.
gdpr.analyticsBody: We use the PostHog analytics tool to measure traffic and improve the website. Based on your consent, we process data about your visit, such as IP address, browser and device type, pages visited and approximate location.
gdpr.cookiesBody: Analytics cookies only run after you give consent. PostHog cookies are used to recognise repeat visits and are stored for up to 365 days. You can change or withdraw your consent at any time.
gdpr.legalBasisBody: We process analytics data based on your consent under Article 6(1)(a) GDPR. Consent is voluntary and you can withdraw it at any time without affecting how the website works.
gdpr.retentionBody: We keep analytics data for as long as necessary, up to a maximum of 13 months from collection.
gdpr.rightsIntro: In connection with the processing of personal data you have the right to:
gdpr.rightsContact: To exercise any of these rights, write to us at adam.dalecky@genzconsulting.cz. We will respond to your request within 30 days.
gdpr.complaintBody: If you believe the processing of personal data violates applicable law, you can lodge a complaint with the Czech Office for Personal Data Protection (uoou.cz).
